title: GitHub Portfolio Search
one_liner: Semantic search engine for personal GitHub repositories using embeddings and TF-IDF.
what_it_is: A tool that indexes GitHub repositories, extracts README content, generates embeddings, and provides a searchable interface via CLI, web UI, and MCP server. It enables developers to find reusable code patterns and architectures across their own portfolio.
how_its_built: Built with Python for the indexing pipeline (using sentence-transformers and SQLite-vec), FastAPI for the REST API, and static HTML/JS for the client-side web UI. Deployment uses AWS S3, CloudFront, and Lambda functions for OAuth and logging.
how_to_apply: Clone the repo, configure a GitHub token, index your repositories using the CLI, and serve the web UI or deploy to AWS. AI agents can integrate via the MCP server to search your codebase programmatically.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/github-portfolio-search.git
cd github-portfolio-search
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cp .env.example .env
ghps index <your_github_username>
ghps export
cd web && python3 -m http.server 8000
features: Client-side semantic search using TF-IDF and embeddings
Automatic clustering of repositories by capability
MCP server integration for AI agent access
Faceted filtering by language, tech stack, and stars
Weekly automated reindexing via GitHub Actions
